486:t_023:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't give in, $$鉄人$$! You're the power of hope Dad left me...!」

486:t_023:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You're the Messenger of the Sun!」

486:t_024:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What?! That Earthling brat broke through my psychic waves?!」

486:t_024:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! Hit $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ with the sun's power and the feelings of everyone who fights with us!」

486:t_025:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「How's that, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$?! Did you see the power of the solar energy converter Dr. $$敷島$$ improved?!」

486:t_025:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「When did you get something like that?!」

486:t_025:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I gave Dr. $$敷島$$ the data from when $$ゲシュタルト$$ made $$鉄人$$ go berserk. He modified it to counter that.」

486:t_025:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Now $$鉄人$$ can release solar energy and unleash incredible power without ever going berserk!」

486:t_025:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「Using power for what is right, without ever becoming consumed by it...」

486:t_026:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's right, $$ダイターン$$... We can't let them outdo us.」

486:t_026:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ダイターン３$$ is alive...」

486:t_026:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「...$$ダイターン$$ is a prototype $$メガボーグ$$. It has a will of its own, though it rarely shows it.」

486:t_026:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「And now... Receiving the solar energy $$鉄人$$ released has allowed $$ダイターン$$ to grow!」

486:t_026:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「Of course! Even the $$メガノイド$$s were originally created with dreams of the future!」

486:t_026:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「With the sun's radiance held in my heart, my body... $$ダイターン$$ is burning!」

486:t_027:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$勝平$$, $$ワッ太$$! Now $$ダイターン$$ should be able to perform combination attacks with your upgraded robots!」

486:t_027:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's do it! It's been a while!」

486:t_028:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! I, too, once hated human selfishness as fiercely as you do!」

486:t_028:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I also learned that this very selfishness is what makes humans human!」

486:t_028:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I refuse...! I won't be consumed by selfishness, and I won't reject it entirely!」

486:t_029:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But if humanity advances... They will be waiting...」

486:t_029:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whatever lies ahead, we won't stop fighting!」

486:t_029:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No matter who the enemy is, we'll win!」

486:t_029:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is humanity's power! The power of life!」

486:t_030:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here we go, $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$!」

486:t_031:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! I, too, once hated human selfishness as fiercely as you do!」

486:t_031:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I also learned that this very selfishness is what makes humans human!」

486:t_031:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I refuse...! I won't be consumed by selfishness, and I won't reject it entirely!」

486:t_032:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But if humanity advances... They will be waiting...」

486:t_032:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Whatever lies ahead, we will keep fighting, and we will win!」

486:t_032:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is humanity's power! The power of life!」

486:t_033:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Awesome! $$ダイターン３$$ powered up, too!」

486:t_033:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Now $$ダイターン$$ should be able to perform combination attacks with your upgraded robots, too.」

486:t_034:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Impossible...! Are they reaching the sun's radiance on their own?!」

486:t_034:1.en:
$$不動$$
「Yes. They are worthy of it.」

486:t_034:2.en:
$$不動$$
「That is the light shining within them... What we call radiance.」

486:t_035:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Accept it, Father. And you, Emperor $$ズール$$.」

486:t_035:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$! Would you defy your own father?!」

486:t_035:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...That day, 12,000 years ago... When our planet was swallowed by a black hole, you changed, Father...」

486:t_035:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「We should have advanced toward the sun's radiance like the Earthlings. Instead, we fell into darkness and lost sight of the light.」

486:t_035:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「All I can do is free you from it, Father!」

486:t_035:6.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Very well, $$グーラ$$. You are no longer my son.」

486:t_035:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Earthlings. You have indeed grown stronger.」

486:t_035:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「Fighting you will require suitable preparations.」

486:t_035:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you running away, $$ズール$$?!」

486:t_035:10.en:
$$ズール$$
「Mind your words, $$マーズ$$. This is not where we shall meet you in battle.」

486:t_035:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I shall await you, Earthlings... And $$グーラ$$. Until you come to the true battlefield.」

486:t_037:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I will be your opponent.」

486:t_037:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「So they left $$ゲシュタルト$$ behind!」

486:t_037:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think an avatar can stop us now!」

486:t_038:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... Now I will fight alongside you.」

486:t_038:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... This day has finally come.」

486:t_038:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father and $$ズール$$ will be waiting for you. There is no need to chase them.」

486:t_038:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「From now on, I will fight alongside you and free them from the depths of darkness!」

486:t_039:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've been waiting for this moment!」

486:t_039:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Now we just have to finish off the rest and get back to our world!」

486:t_039:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That's right, $$ミカゲ$$! If you want to fight, I'll take you on, too!」
